candidates.title: Turn rough sketches into wireframes

demandEvidence.chore: Translate rough iPad sketches into higher-fidelity wireframes or illustrations.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: I’ve been looking for a tool that can translate rough sketches on my iPad to higher fidelity wireframes or illustrations in near real time.

experimentPlan.output: A review sheet with a proposed wireframe draft beside each supplied rough sketch.
inputs: Short description of intended screen purpose
Chosen image transformation tool operated by the student
experimentPlan.trigger: An operator selects one sketch for a supervised prototype run.
steps: Record the sketch and intended purpose.
Ask a person to define required visible elements.
Try one transformation using a chosen tool.
Place the output beside the input and checklist.
Have a person mark preserved, changed and missing elements.
Save the comparison for review, not production use.
experimentPlan.acceptanceCheck: On three synthetic sketches, compare output with the checklist and verify changed or missing elements are visible for review.
experimentPlan.humanBoundary: A person supplies rights-cleared sketches, operates the tool, checks fidelity and approves any output before use.
unverified: No supplied reference documents sketch-to-wireframe generation, integration, fidelity or repeatable image processing; the core capability remains unverified.

ease.reason: A person can compare supplied sketches, but no supplied implementation reference supports image transformation.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: independent designers or small design studios may pay for faster sketch refinement; this request proves neither buyer interest nor payment.

feasibility.reason: A supervised comparison prototype is bounded, but its core image transformation and fidelity remain unverified.

autonomy.reason: Transformation quality, integration and repeatable processing are unsupported; a person must review every result.

evidence.reason: The fresh request states a specific sketch transformation need, but gives no frequency, workflow detail or corroboration.

candidates.reason: Below the 6-point threshold: no supplied implementation evidence supports the core transformation.
